scope: Prior published or university-archived research on Zi Wei Dou Shu and related chart prediction methods, kept separate from the HumanDesign Project prospective human tests.
scientific_objective: Identify already conducted human studies, report positive and negative observations without selective omission, and prevent source-count or synthetic-chart tests from being interpreted as independent human predictive evidence.

studies.comparison_method_reported: Researchers correlated practitioner judgments from Zi Wei Dou Shu chart-reading questions with participants' independently completed psychological inventories
studies.authors_reported_main_outcome_summary: No significant overall correlations were reported between Zi Wei practitioner judgments and validated psychological inventories; no significant associations reported after splitting by gender and by Eastern/Western religious affiliation.
authors_reported_secondary_observations: A weak positive friendliness correlation reported within respondents who had a religion.
A marginal-significance friendliness correlation reported among respondents who did not believe in Zi Wei Dou Shu.
studies.next_verification_needed: Obtain lawful full thesis copy to examine 7 astrology items, exact birth data and birth-hour basis, practitioner blinding, correlation matrix, effect sizes, multiplicity correction, subgroup sizes and whether any prespecified directional tests were used.
